summary: Improve payroll data mapping, interface testing, and reconciliation skills. Explore practical HR tech integration strategies and enrol.
lede: Payroll integration coordinates employee, time, benefits, and pay data across connected systems. For HRIS, payroll systems, and integration professionals, the course builds practical skills in defining field mappings and interface specifications, monitoring interface runs, validating changes through testing and reconciliation, managing exceptions, and planning cutovers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect HR and payroll platforms with time, benefits, finance, and related systems, and who need reliable, secure data exchange. This course is designed for: Payroll Systems Analysts monitoring interfaces and investigating payroll output exceptions. HRIS Integrations Analysts maintaining employee data flows between connected applications. HRIS Analysts validating employee records and supporting HR system integrations. Payroll Integration Consultants translating requirements into field mappings and interface specifications. HR Technology Project Managers coordinating interface testing, deployment, and post-release support. Payroll Operations Leads comparing system results before payroll approval. Benefits Systems Analysts validating deduction and enrolment data exchanges. Time and Attendance Systems Analysts troubleshooting hours and schedule data transfers. Finance Systems Analysts reconciling payroll cost data with finance records. Information Security Analysts reviewing access controls for sensitive payroll interfaces.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with HRIS or payroll operations, employee data, or business-system interfaces is expected. No programming is required for the course exercises; they focus on requirements, mapping, test design, validation, and documentation. Advanced integration engineering is covered at an operational planning level, not as hands-on platform configuration.
